card.title: 81. INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.text: Has +3 attack against HQs and units with Guard.
card.flavorText: The 81st Infantry Regiment was a unit of the 15th Infantry Division of the Wehrmacht that was formed in 1934 and stayed active until the end of WWII. The division fought in the Battle of France and in 1941 it was transferred to the Eastern Front where it joined the XXXV Army Corps of Army Group Centre. After that the 15th Infantry Division fought in numerous battles and campaigns on the Eastern Front, including the Battle of Smolensk, the Battle of Moscow, the Third Battle of Kharkov, and finally in Romania during the Second Jassy–Kishinev Offensive of 1944 where the division was destroyed. The division was reformed in 1944 and fought the remainder of the war in Hungary and in Slovakia where they finally surrendered to Soviet troops.
